sinopsis.es: En un mundo de montañas imponentes, Peregrin, un meticuloso conductor de tren, mantiene su máquina en marcha con precisión. Cuando la inquieta música Clara se cuela en la cabina, una catástrofe los obliga a superar sus diferencias para evitar el descarrilamiento.
sinopsis.en: In a world dominated by towering, steep mountains, pedantic train conductor Peregrin navigates his train over huge bridges and along dangerous ridges. Like a clockwork, he follows the world’s very own rhythm - he has to, if he wants to bring the passengers safely to their destination.
